items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Well, Wesley was -- wanted to get in a fight

ctx.x: Probably about something, music or something. They got to arguing and been drinking, you know. Well, Wesley was -- wanted to get in a fight, but they were how musicians are, just, you know, it was just a joke. So I couldn't duck it. So when Ben Webster and them saw me and Bob Carroll, hey, Happy, Happy Caldwell, (unintelligible) straighten that out right now. Happy, come here. I said, oh, boy.
